items.q: In one well-known UCL study, how long did new habits take to feel automatic on average?
items.why: Lally et al. (2009): 18 to 254 days, average about 66. The '21 days' idea is a myth.

items.q: Does missing a single day ruin a new habit?
items.why: The same study found a single missed day didn't hurt habit formation.
